scope: Applied modular player, enemy and cut presentation; templates are not generated assets, executed changes or playtests

prompts.intent: Refine an original Ukrainian FPV body and responsive propellers without changing movement or contact
prompts.prompt: Inspect the actual {{SOURCE_ART}}, registered {{BODY_ID}} rig and {{TARGET_PACK}}. Create a separate original Ukrainian FPV body variation with a recognizable camera, compact X frame and Ukrainian blue/yellow identity; no Z markings. Use the image tool's inspected-reference editing workflow when producing art, preserving the source. Keep the existing source rectangle, center, upward facing convention, contained image aspect ratio and measured rotor anchors. Make four hubs with three configurable blades per hub; retain spin signs, phase offsets and alias-aware sampling. Body facing reads resolved player.direction, rate reads actual player.speed, and buffered requests never become premature visual turns. Keep body, rotor recipe and trail independently replaceable through existing interfaces; player is the image slot, not a new rotor or trail manifest field. Preserve the current player image-box target of 24–32 CSS pixels on desktop and at least 16 on ordinary phones, bounded by 64 logical pixels; measure actual occupied alpha/rotor extent rather than claiming the box is the silhouette. Keep playerScale independent of actorScale and the exact rules.playerRadius ring outside cosmetic transforms. Inspect idle, moving, turning, boost, respawn, Pause and reduced-effects playback; enemy freeze must not freeze player rotors. Compare both steering modes with their own unchanged input fixtures and retain an authored stopOnCapture/fresh-direction contract. Run the relevant presentation checks and actual browser playback at phone and desktop board sizes. Deliver original/derived art paths, effective prompt, anchor/recipe diff, measured sizes and evidence; do not claim a concept sheet is a working animation or copy XPOSED assets.
prompts.example_request: Apply presentation-01-fpv-rig with BODY_ID=fpv-body, SOURCE_ART=authoring/motion-lab/assets/fpv-body.png and TARGET_PACK=game/content/packs/fpv-arcade-r2.json; make the camera and three-blade rotors easier to read without changing the flight path.

prompts.intent: Replace enemy art across four themes with distinct motion silhouettes and unchanged role cues
prompts.prompt: Inspect {{TARGET_PACK}}, the active role arrays and the saved reference frames. Produce original enemy replacements in {{DETAIL_TREATMENTS}} using the supported microtile, hybrid and props treatments. Compare four shape vocabularies on the same board: FPV tracked vehicles/quads/radar, Ukrainian patterned beetles and botanical guardians, 1994 robots/comets/glitches, and Coupa-inspired invoices/parcels/linked blocks. Use distinct shapes rather than palette-only variants, and no Z markings in FPV art. Bind exact roles: bouncer to enemy, border-patrol to patrol, lane-boss/staged core to boss, contour-patrol to contour, claimed-rover to rover, eroder to eroder. Keep background, player, objective, supply and wall independent. Classic-only contour, rover, eroder, slowTerrain, lethalTerrain, lifePickup, speedPickup, slowPickup and freezePickup require the Classic scenario format; do not add them to older formats or invent new keys. Keep enemy contact centers/radii and all warning, rejoining, dormant, slow/frozen and pickup-type cues above replacements. Bodies face upward at zero rotation; facing follows observed tick positions, with initial velocity only a fallback. Moving treads/walking track travel while rotors/radar may idle; freeze, stun, dormancy and Pause hold their relevant clocks. Reduced effects keep clear static cues. Target 18–28 CSS-pixel ordinary bodies on desktop and at least 12 on ordinary phones, with 48 logical maximum (boss 34 CSS/60 logical); actorScale remains cosmetic. Keep tails to at most three nearby points within 1.15 cells. Preserve complete simulation definitions, score authority and each turn mode's checkpoint. Validate each changed binding and inspect decoded art plus real playback at actual sizes. Use XPOSED only to compare hierarchy/readability; do not extract its artwork or infer animation timing from stills. Report generated assets, wiring and playback evidence separately.
prompts.example_request: Apply presentation-02-four-theme-enemies with TARGET_PACK=game/content/packs/classic-lab.json and DETAIL_TREATMENTS=microtile,hybrid,props; distinguish the contour patrol and claimed-ground rover in every theme.

prompts.intent: Improve active-line and earned-picture feedback while preserving hazards, reduced effects and reward authority
prompts.prompt: Inspect {{TARGET_PACK}} and refine its presentation toward {{EFFECT_DIRECTION}} using the existing trail/capture renderer. Keep source art and exact gameplay definitions intact. Unrevealed artwork remains opaque black; actors, hazards and live lines remain legible above it. Preserve the current live-cut hierarchy: 8 logical pixels of dark contrast, 4 accent, 1 light center, an 8/4 head and at most one 3-pixel moving highlight on the last short section of the actual line. Keep the static trail-cell cue; do not scatter sparks over collision routes or bake gameplay into the background. Capture feedback consumes actual cells.claimed indices only: copied/bounded to 2592, with only currently SAFE cells painted, less than 0.65 seconds duration and opacity no greater than 0.2; retain the bounded eight-effect queue. Pause freezes ordinary effect age. Reduced effects remove moving highlights and capture pulses while preserving the line/head, material warnings and contact cues. The effect cannot change position, coverage, score, damage, awards or an authored stopOnCapture/fresh-direction rule. Full-picture victory follows the real win, retains recorded coverage and its separate celebration pause/lifecycle behavior; replaying Collection cannot grant a second award. Do not invent trail/capture JSON override keys or promise unsupported video generation. Run the focused actor, Classic, wide, reward and reduced-gallery checks, then inspect rapid cuts, overlapping warnings, pause/resume and completed-picture playback in the browser at phone/desktop sizes. Compare original work against reference rhythm without copying XPOSED images, sprites or music. Deliver the smallest presentation change, actual evidence and remaining visual limitations; passing tests alone does not prove the experience is beautiful or fun.
prompts.example_request: Apply presentation-03-cut-reveal with TARGET_PACK=game/content/packs/fpv-arcade-r2.json and EFFECT_DIRECTION=A brighter short trail head and a quiet diagonal sweep over newly secured cells.
